title: validate_session_urls safe comment addresses panic not correctness
description: client.rs validate_session_urls (line 512): comment reads '// safe: split always yields at least one element'. This comment explains why the unwrap() won't panic but does not explain whether the scheme extraction is semantically correct. A reader auditing security properties will ask: 'does split on ":// " correctly identify the scheme?' and the comment does not answer that. The comment should instead note that this is a heuristic and explain why a URL parser is not used here, or the code should be changed to use url::Url::parse which makes the comment unnecessary.
